poses.label: Reach
poses.description: Set your thighs under the pad, lean back slightly, and reach up with long arms.

poses.label: Pull
poses.description: Drive your elbows down as you bring the bar toward your chest.

poses.label: Chest
poses.description: Bring the bar to your upper chest while keeping your thighs under the pad.

poses.label: Return
poses.description: Let the bar rise under control until your arms are long again.

checks: Thighs under the pad, small torso lean, elbows driving down, upper-chest finish and controlled reach.
Compared pose captions with the exact built-in exercise cue.
Checked camera bounds, equipment anchoring, and contact throughout the interpolated loop.
limitations: The simplified figure and fixed camera show the main movement path. In-app phone playback and admin review are pending.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
